in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of Waters
in_marathi.long_meaning: Jalaj हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Jalaj is a Sanskrit name derived from the word 'jal,' which means water. In Hindu mythology, Jalaj is the name of a demon king who was the lord of all waters. He was a powerful and feared deity who controlled the oceans and rivers.
